title: Webb County Sheriff’s Office Joins Career Day at Triumph Laredo South
excerpt: The Webb County Sheriff’s Office Community Affairs Division took part in Career Day at Triumph Laredo South on Tuesday, giving students a look at law enforcement, public service and the career paths available within the agency.
content:
The Webb County Sheriff’s Office Community Affairs Division took part in Career Day at Triumph Laredo South on Tuesday, according to the Sheriff’s Office.

Representatives from the agency met with students to talk about law enforcement, public service and the many career paths available within the Sheriff’s Office.

The office said its representatives enjoyed engaging with students, answering their questions and sharing the importance of leadership and teamwork.

Sheriff Martin Cuellar thanked Triumph Laredo South for the invitation, saying the school helped students explore their future possibilities.

Source: Webb County Sheriff's Office, Facebook, Nov. 18, 2026.
